Programme Details

Here is an overview of how our Computer Science programme is planned to run. Final details will be confirmed with each cohort.

Sample details shown. Final information will be updated soon.

First Courses & Tracks
Python fundamentals, web basics (HTML, CSS, JavaScript), and problem-solving with logic and algorithms.
Target Learners
Students in grades 8-12 (ages 12-18). No prior coding experience needed for the beginner track.
Instructors
Mentors with industry and teaching experience guide each batch. Profiles will be shared here.
Class Format & Schedule
Live online sessions of 60-90 minutes, in small groups of up to 8. Weekday evening and weekend slots.
Course Fees & Pricing
Starting from ₹X,XXX per month. Free introductory session available.
